note: 2016-05-12 Figures were revised for the period 2013.
Changes in sector classification (INSEKT 2014) mainly affect the balance sheet due to some businesses being reclassified to the financial or public sector.
2017-05-11. Ericsson AB has been reclassified as a service producing company from the reference year 2015.

2019-05-08 From the dissemination of data for 2017 and onwards, holding companies, whose sole task is to own other holding companies, are excluded. This change has the greatest impact on balance sheet items and total assets, but may also to a certain extent, affect profit and loss items.

2020-05-06 When publishing the 2018 data, a small number of enterprises in the industries 59, 60, 86 and 91 (NACE Rev.2) have been reclassified to the public sector and are no longer included in the survey.
As of 2020, the post “improvement expenses on someone else’s property”, has been redistributed from the variable machinery and equipment to the variable buildings, land facilities and land.

2022-05-04 As of 2020, the post “improvement expenses on someone else’s property”, has been redistributed from the variable machinery and equipment to the variable buildings, land facilities and land.

The correction affects the production value within NACE Rev. 2 divisions 26, 29 and 35 and the stock change in NACE Rev. 2 division 29. The data published for kind-of-activity income and cost variables has been affected for these divisions.  Other minor changes on the 2011 data can also be found  over all divisions.
